_comment: NPC dialogue for magistrate_voss (Phase E §3 barks; quest lines land with Act 1).

1.speaker: Magistrate Voss
1.text: The magistrate will talk about the ash road once the ledger balances, and the ledger needs six bolts' worth of cloth.

2.speaker: Magistrate Voss
2.text: Gather 6 Torn Cloth. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Magistrate Voss
1.text: Voss admits the warrens under the ash road are not a vermin problem. He wants to know what they actually are.

2.speaker: Magistrate Voss
2.text: Reach Entered Emberling Warrens. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Magistrate Voss
1.text: Voss keeps his hands folded and his papers exactly square.

3.speaker: Magistrate Voss
3.text: The signatures are all perfect. That is the first thing I stopped trusting about them.

4.speaker: Magistrate Voss
4.text: Filed. Where they belong. If a thing is filed properly nobody has to look at it again, and that is the whole point of filing.

5.speaker: Magistrate Voss
5.text: On the nights the bell is quiet. It has not been quiet in some time.

2.speaker: Magistrate Voss
2.text: Go on. I have the time, which is the only thing anyone in this valley still has in quantity.

choices.text: What happened to the millhaven ledgers?

barks.text: Order is not cruelty. Order is what keeps the chaos at the gate.
You will find, in time, that the law is a convenience of the ones who write it.
Careful. You speak to the only peace Sunreach has known.
